rationale: Repair the governed publication-spec builder so it preserves the existing PublicationDecisionInput contract, where boundary_authorization is optional. Specs that have no resolvable publication boundary may omit the authorization object instead of manufacturing a bound_not_published token. Existing authorized publication specs remain unchanged and compatible.
supersession_impact: None. No capability or publication authority is superseded.
authority_impact: No new publication authority is introduced. The repair only aligns the governed data builder with the already-versioned publication-decision contract; publication permission and authoritative publication remain controlled by the existing evaluator and authoritative gate.
